summary_en: MUTO SEIKO will acquire up to 130,000 shares (1.9% of issued shares excluding treasury stock) for a maximum of ¥3.0 billion through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from September 11, 2026 to March 31, 2027, to enhance shareholder returns and improve capital efficiency.
title_en: Notice regarding Determination of Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: The company resolved at its board of directors meeting held on September 10, 2026 to acquire treasury shares under the provisions of the Companies Act. The acquisition will target a maximum of 130,000 ordinary shares, representing 1.9% of issued shares excluding treasury stock. The acquisition price ceiling is set at ¥3.0 billion. Purchases will be made on the Tokyo Stock Exchange through market transactions between September 11, 2026 and March 31, 2027. The company stated that the primary objectives of the acquisition are to enhance shareholder returns and improve capital efficiency.
